title: Uptake of per- and polyfluorinated alkyl substances by dry farmed oats following the agricultural application of biosolids and compost
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00502C, Paper
Gabrielle P. Black, Luann Wong, Thomas M. Young
A field study of two sites with 6–44 year histories of biosolids applications showed no detectable uptake of per- and poly-fluorinated alkyl substances (PFAS) with C3–C18 chain lengths in dry farmed oats despite detectable concentrations in soil.
